title: Run-Length Encoding

attempts.diagnostic: Datatype Run expected 0 predicate arguments and got 1. The original canonicality predicate was therefore repaired to quantify over the run representative value instead of Run a.

attempts.result: rejected during synthesis; no candidate emitted
attempts.diagnostic: Synquid reached the encode goal but attempted to synthesize the declared polymorphic equality component and failed with: Cannot match shape 'Bool' with shape '_' when checking eq.

required_features.why: The exact OCaml interface is polymorphic and run boundaries require deciding whether adjacent elements are equal. The pinned runtime has no executable trusted equality component for an abstract type variable; it tries to synthesize eq and rejects the goal.

required_features.feature: backend lowering from structural Run/Runs values to (int * 'a) list
required_features.why: The full Synquid contract represents positive counts structurally (leader plus same-valued tail) so it can preserve ordered expansion. The reusable typed backend must lower that representation mechanically; no OCaml lowering or target implementation appears in this item.

semantic_obligations: Each output pair represents one maximal non-empty contiguous input run and has a strictly positive count.
Output run order equals left-to-right input traversal order.
Expanding every (count, value) pair reconstructs the input exactly, preserving ordering and multiplicity.
Adjacent output pairs have distinct representative values; equal values separated by another value remain distinct runs.
The API is pure and deterministic, has no specified errors/options, mutation, randomness, float/string special cases, or infinite-stream behavior.
